text:
zoe: Quick intake  EdgeWorks customer spotlight + 20s quote + 8-12m interview clip for the June webinar promo. Target publish June 30. Can we record next Wed/Thu mornings?

mike: Morning ok. I'll jump on to cover product impact.

harper: For lead routing, send webinar signups to SFDC campaign 'EdgeWorks Launch Jun' -> SDR queue 'Enterprise - Retail'. Also want separate CTA for paid traffic -> demo.

tara: Legal: need signed release before publish and quote approval before any social. Numeric claims require Research backup. Drop draft quote here and I'll quick-review.

zoe: Draft quote: "Redwood brought our inference costs down by ~2.7x, letting us roll out new features faster." Thoughts?

lucas: I ran the EdgeWorks runs. Median cost improvement = 2.72x on their retail workload (100k sample). Fine to say "~2.7x" if you link the benchmark CSV and a 2-line methodology. I'll upload the files tonight.

tara: With Research doc we can approve the figure, but legal wants a one-sentence methodology on the landing page (what sample, what metric) and a parenthetical link to the report.

harper: Ops note: make sure forms set hidden fields: utm_source, utm_campaign, paid=true/false. I'll coordinate with Ops to map to SFDC.

ops-bot: Created ticket ops-5591 for SFDC mapping. Required fields: CampaignMemberStatus='Registered', utm_source, utm_medium, utm_campaign, paid_flag.

publish-bot: Intake created: asset-22990. Checklist: schedule recording, signed release, quote approval, attach benchmark link+method, UTM + SFDC mapping, asset tagging.

zoe: Proposed recording slot: Thu 6/15 9:30am PT (30m block: 10m prebrief, 20m recording). Who needs calendar invite?

mike: Send to me + lucas + tara. I'll have product slides ready.

harper: Add an SDR rep for handoff notes.

tara: I'll review release if quote + benchmark link are posted by EOD Tue.

lucas: Uploading: https://drive.redwood/reports/edgeworks-benchmark.csv and README. Methodology snippet: "100k-request sample, median per-request inference cost, same model config across baselines." Paste the one-liner on the landing page and link to the report.

zoe: Nice. I'll update quote to: "Redwood cut our inference costs by ~2.7x, which sped up our release cadence." Will attach the report link in the parenthetical.

tara: Quick redline: remove "cut"  prefer "reduced". Also ask to avoid implying attribution of speed solely to cost reduction. Suggest: "Redwood reduced our inference costs by ~2.7x and helped us ship features faster."

mike: Agree with Legal wording.

harper: Looks good. On CTAs: paid ads -> demo form, organic -> webinar RSVP. Make sure UTM differences are clear.

zoe: Locked the slot and sent invites. Added pre-interview brief and the release template to the intake ticket. Will include UTM spec and SFDC campaign name in calendar. Thanks! :tada!
